Summary: Biblical wisdom is skill in living well under God's rule, beginning with the fear of the Lord. Proverbs, Job, and Ecclesiastes teach that wisdom is found not in cleverness but in trusting God, listening to counsel, and walking humbly. Jesus is presented as wisdom itself, greater than Solomon, calling us to build our lives on His words.
KeyPassages: Job 28:28; Psalm 90:12; Proverbs 1:7; Proverbs 3:5-6; Ecclesiastes 12:13; Matthew 7:24; 1 Corinthians 1:30; James 3:17
RelatedDoctrines: Wisdom; Fear of the Lord; Providence
RelatedQuestions: What is biblical wisdom and how do I get it?; Why does the book of Ecclesiastes sound so pessimistic?
